matched_contract.text: Pocket TTS runs entirely on this Android phone using the original floating point model.
matched_contract.voice: provenance-pinned Bria reference WAV from the sherpa Pocket archive, originally from kyutai-labs/delayed-streams-modeling

routes.onnx: controlled unquantized floating-point five-component export with explicit state and host autoregressive/flow orchestration; ONNX Runtime CPU
routes.executorch: torch.export each callable component with explicit state and host orchestration; ExecuTorch portable CPU or XNNPACK only if faithful

benchmark.memory_limitation: Peak RSS is sampled process VmHWM or Android /proc status high-water; it includes runtime, model mappings, working buffers and output, not isolated tensor memory.
benchmark.thermal_caveat: Sequential same-device runs can inherit thermal/DVFS state; record order and do not claim laboratory thermal control.

claim_boundaries: A safetensors checkpoint is original weights, not an Android-executable graph.
A controlled export is a derived mobile representation, not the original model file.
No HTP, QNN, quantization, or accelerator compatibility claims are in scope.
A route blocked before complete text-to-WAV is not a mobile success.
